'''''Rubus fruticosus'' L.''' is the ambiguous name of a European [[blackberry]] species in the genus ''[[Rubus]]'' (part of the [[rose family]]). The name has been interpreted in several ways:

*The species represented by the [[type specimen]] of ''Rubus fruticosus'' L., which is also the type specimen of the genus ''Rubus''.<ref>{{citation |url=http://botany.si.edu/ing/ |title=Index Nominum Genericorum |editor=Farr, E. R. and G. Zijlstra |access-date=15 May 2015 |publisher=Smithsonian Institution}}</ref> This specimen is considered to match the species ''[[Rubus plicatus|R. plicatus]]'', in ''Rubus'' [[subgenus]] ''Rubus'', [[section (botany)|section]] ''Rubus''.<ref>{{GRIN | ''Rubus plicatus'' | 32419 | access-date = 15 May 2015}}</ref><ref name=Stace>{{cite book |author=Stace, C. |author-link = Clive Stace|year=2010  |title=New Flora of the British Isles |publisher=Cambridge University Press |location=Cambridge |isbn=978-0521707725 }}</ref>
* Various species consistent with [[Carl Linnaeus]]' original description of the species, which was based on a mixture of specimens now considered to match ''[[Rubus ulmifolius]]''{{citation needed|date=May 2019}} and ''R. plicatus''
*a [[species aggregate]] (group of similar species) '''''Rubus fruticosus'' agg.''' (a ''[[nomen ambiguum]]'') that includes most (or rarely all) of a group called ''Rubus'' subgenus ''Rubus''<ref name=Stace/> (or less often: ''Rubus'' section ''Rubus'' [sensu latissimo]):<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=128837#KEY-1-2|title=Rubus in Flora of China |website=Efloras.org|access-date=26 March 2022}}</ref><ref name=Jarvis/>
** in a narrow sense, sometimes separated as the section ''Glandulosus'' (alternative name: subsection ''Hiemales'') In this sense the species aggregate does not include the type of the genus ''Rubus''.
** in a broad sense: (1) (i) sections  ''Glandulosus'' and ''Rubus'' [sensu stricto] (in non-British systems, these two sections are classified together as section ''Rubus'' [sensu lato], section Glandulosus being called subsection ''Hiemales'' and section Rubus [sensu stricto] being called subsection ''Rubus'')<ref>{{cite journal|url=http://www.flora-deutschlands.de/arbeitsgruppe_rubus/files/175-Weber--Westf-Rubus-Update-2008.pdf|journal=Abhandlungen aus dem Westfälischen Museum für Naturkunde|volume=70|pages=289–304|date=2008|title=Aktuelle Übersicht über die Brombeerflora in Westfalen (Rubus L. subgen. Rubus)|author=Heinrich E. Weber|access-date=26 March 2022}}</ref><ref name=Jarvis/><ref>{{GRIN | ''Rubus'' L. subg. Rubus | 18638 | access-date = 1 May 2019}}</ref> or (ii) "most of" these sections;<ref>{{GRIN | ''Rubus fruticosus'' auct. | 419819 | access-date = 15 May 2015}}</ref> or (2) sections ''Glandulosus'', ''Rubus'' [sensu stricto] and ''Corylifolii''.<ref name=Stace/> Section ''Rubus'' [sensu stricto]  are probably hybrids involving members of section ''Glandulosus'' with either ''[[Rubus idaeus|R. idaeus]]'' or ''[[Rubus allegheniensis|R. allegheniensis]]''.<ref name=Stace/> Section ''Corylifolii''  are probably hybrids involving members of section ''Glandulosus'' with ''[[Rubus caesius|R. caesius]]''.<ref name=Stace/>
** even more broadly, including all the taxa in the subgenus ''Rubus''<ref name=Jarvis>{{cite journal |author=Jarvis, C.E. |year=1992 |title=Seventy-Two Proposals for the Conservation of Types of Selected Linnaean Generic Names, the Report of Subcommittee 3C on the Lectotypification of Linnaean Generic Names |journal=Taxon |volume=41 |issue=3 |pages=552–583 |jstor=1222833 |doi=10.2307/1222833 |bibcode=1992Taxon..41..552J }}</ref><ref>{{GRIN | ''Rubus fruticosus'' L. sensu typo | 32322 | access-date = 1 May 2019}}</ref>

==Incorrect applications==
Apart from the established meaning of ''Rubus fruticosus'' L. as ''R. plicatus'', the name ''R. fruticosus'' has been incorrectly applied to several species, including:
* ''Rubus fructicosus'' Weihe & Nees, Rubi Germ. 24, 1822 -> ''[[Rubus montanus]]'' Lib. ex Lej., Fl. Spa 2: 317, 1813 (or part of ''R. montanus'')<ref>{{Cite book | last1 = Mansfeld | first1 = Rudolf | title = Mansfeld's Encyclopedia of Agricultural and Horticultural Crops ((Except Ornamentals)) | publisher = Springer Science & Business Media | year = 2001 |isbn = 978-3-540-41017-1| page = 436 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|author=KIRÁLYI, G.|title=Reopening an old chapter: A revised taxonomic and evolutionary concept of the Rubus montanus group.|journal=Preslia |volume=89|issue=4|pages=309–331|date=December 2017|doi=10.23855/preslia.2017.309 |url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/321461793|access-date=27 April 2019|doi-access=free}}</ref>
* ''Rubus fruticosus'' G.N.Jones -> ''[[Rubus vestitus]]'' Weihe<ref name=PL>{{Cite web|url=http://www.theplantlist.org/tpl1.1/search?q=rubus+fruticosus|title=Search results — The Plant List|website=Theplantlist.org|access-date=26 March 2022}}</ref>
* ''Rubus fruticosus'' L. ex Dierb. -> ''[[Rubus vulgaris]]'' Weihe & Nees<ref name=PL/>
* ''Rubus fruticosus'' Lour.  -> ''[[Rubus cochinchinensis]]'' Tratt.<ref name=PL/>
